Civil Judge, & Member, Mact, Court Of Small Causes,
Bengaluru, (Scch-18), Awarding Compensation Of
Rs.8,09,000/- With Interest @ 9% P.A. From The Date Of
Petition Till Deposit.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
The appellant till today, has not deposited the amount while he preferring the appeal.
It is a mandatory on part of the owner to deposit the amount as per Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
But the learned counsel for the appellant pleaded inability to deposit the amount.
The appeal is filed by the owner.
Since the Tribunal has fastened the liability on the owner but the learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the appellant is unable to deposit the amount.
Hence, mandatory requirement is not complied with by the appellant/owner of the offending vehicle.
Hence, the appeal is dismissed for non-compliance of mandatory provision.

Sd/-
